gate.deviation: D-1: contention measured directly; load average recorded, not gated

closing_gate.sampling: median of 3 top -l 2 samples 5 s apart, D-1a exclusions
closing_gate.rule: the closing sample is held to the same idle/busiest-process constants as the start gate; a failing group is DISCARDED - its rows, metadata and summary are kept and a DISCARDED marker is written, and the run exits 4 - so a discarded window is disclosed rather than dropped. SCAP_BENCH_FORCE=1 records the close without gating it, as it does the start.

rustflags_frozen: -C target-cpu=apple-m3 -C target-feature=+neon -C opt-level=3 -C codegen-units=1 -C force-frame-pointers=on -C embed-bitcode=yes -Z dylib-lto -Z mir-opt-level=4 -Z inline-mir=yes -C llvm-args=-unroll-threshold=500 -C llvm-args=-enable-dfa-jump-thread -C link-arg=-Wl,-dead_strip

foreign_hyperfine.rule: any hyperfine whose --export-json is outside out_dir is foreign; a detection aborts the run with exit 3 and writes OUT/CONTAMINATED, so a completed metadata.json always reports an empty list

corpus_inventory.note: dirs_read is not comparable with the frozen figure across walkers; repos_drift is the drift signal
